text: せっかく　てかげん　してやったのに

structure.jp: てかげん　してやったのに
structure.en: even though I went easy on you

patterns.name: 〜のに
patterns.explanation: のに means 'even though', said with disappointment at how things turned out. してやったのに = 'even though I did it for you'.

patterns.name: 〜てやる
patterns.explanation: てやる after a verb means doing something as a favor to someone below you. してやった = 'I did it for you'.

patterns.name: せっかく〜のに
patterns.span: せっかく　てかげん　してやったのに
patterns.explanation: せっかく with のに says a special effort was made and then wasted. せっかく　てかげん　してやったのに = 'and after I took the trouble to go easy on you'.
